detail: Greatest common divisor of the contract's positive OI values; on a day where it disagrees with the turnover rule round(median(value / (contracts x (strike + premium)))) the turnover rule is used, and if the divisor rule agreed with NewBrdLotQty on fewer than 99% of UDiFF contract-days the turnover rule is used throughout. The pre-registration said the divisor is 'checked against' the turnover rule without saying which wins on disagreement.

data/external/other_weekly_expiries.csv was built on 2 Nov 2026 from web search summaries of NSE and BSE notices (FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY, BANKEX, SENSEX50); every row is 'reported', none verified (BSE servers and tradingqna.com not reachable). Scheduled weekly dates are rolled back to the previous NSE trading day; the last scheduled date of each calendar month is the monthly contract and is not counted. Sensex dates come from results/sensex_confound/sensex_expiry_days_used.csv with the last Sensex expiry of each month taken as monthly. Nifty and Bank Nifty weekly dates are their bhavcopy expiry days that are not index futures expiry days.
pinning_study.chain_before; if the t-1 file lists the contract under a holiday re-dated expiry, that listing's turnover, OI and lot size are used for C2, C3 and C5.
Turnover of the contract expiring on E in day t's own bhavcopy (or a listing within 3 days of E) over all options of the index that day.
'At least as large as with the close' compares |gamma at 14:30| with |gamma| of the main model on the full sample; gamma with the official close on the same minute-bar sample is also reported.
An expiry day whose next calendar day is a weekday without trading, and whose weekday differs from the most common expiry weekday of that index within 35 days either side.
Summary files requested with the task; they add no analysis that changes a decision.
The pre-registered rerun of the check that every expiring option's settlement price equals the official close (section 8), by cell.

The pre-registration did not define it. Rule used: C4 is consistent with a contrast if the change in the mean weekly count on expiry days points the way the mechanism needs (fewer weeklies with more pinning); a change smaller than 0.5 weeklies counts as no change, which cannot match a real change in pinning.
